name: AMC Dune
description: A calm, warm style: sand neutrals, a deep indigo primary that leads every action, a sparing terracotta accent and soft long shadows, made for HR and hospitality apps.
helpText: Light style built on Vita. The page and header are warm sand, regions float on soft long shadows, and a deep indigo primary (WCAG AA with white text) carries buttons, links, the current menu entry and focus. Terracotta appears only as a thin accent (the header underline and the current menu marker), never as a status color, so danger stays clearly red. Uses the system font stack. Header and navigation refinements target Universal Theme classes and should be checked on a live page.
